Patch 0.29.21 (Poison damage sync now stays aligned)

  • Authoritative state now also replicates poison damage: Authoritative state now also replicates poison damage so active poison can carry truthful per-tick damage detail instead of relying only on local stack guesses.
  • Poison detail is now more truthful in local sync: This lets local self sync and debuff UI prefer the real server-owned poison tick damage while still falling back to local stack-based detail when that authoritative field is absent.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues one debuff field at a time: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by extending status detail replication one debuff field at a time, following bleed damage with the matching safe poison-owned damage detail.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for authoritative poison damage sync and 0.29.21 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.15 (Slow factor sync now stays aligned)

  • Authoritative state now also replicates slow factor: Authoritative state now also replicates slow factor so active slows can carry truthful strength data instead of only a boolean on/off signal.
  • Slow debuff detail is now more truthful: This lets the local player sync and debuff tracker show the real slow percentage from server state while still avoiding any invented generic durations for other active debuffs.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues carefully: The 0.29 cleanup line continues with the smallest truthful active-status detail replication slice before broader debuff duration work.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for authoritative slow factor sync and 0.29.15 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.14 (Debuff delta sync now stays aligned)

  • Server delta snapshots now track debuff booleans: Server delta snapshots now track stunned, slowed, rooted, bleeding, and poisoned state changes so status-only transitions cannot be skipped by compressed authoritative updates.
  • Status flips now arrive promptly: This keeps the new local debuff-clear path and any remote status consumers supplied with timely authoritative debuff flips instead of relying on unrelated movement or stat changes to carry them through.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues on the server side: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by tightening the server delta broadcaster before any broader status duration replication work.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for debuff flag delta tracking and 0.29.14 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.13 (Authoritative local debuff clears now stay aligned)

  • Local self sync now clears stale debuff state when the server says it is gone: Local authoritative self sync now clears stale debuff timers and stacks when server state explicitly says stun, slow, root, bleed, or poison are no longer active.
  • Debuff truth no longer lingers after authoritative removal: This keeps the local buff tracker and control-state truth from lingering after authoritative status removal without pretending to know missing server-side durations for still-active debuffs.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues carefully: The 0.29 cleanup line continues with a narrow status-model correction that is safe to ship before any broader timer replication redesign.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for authoritative local debuff clears and 0.29.13 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.12 (Local authoritative unlocked talent sync now stays aligned)

  • Local self sync now applies unlocked talent truth during delta updates: Local authoritative self sync now also stores server-sent unlocked talent lists during delta updates instead of treating that field as a change trigger without ever applying it.
  • Talent progression state stays aligned with authoritative player updates: This keeps the local progression state aligned when authoritative player updates include talent unlocks alongside ranks and points, closing one more small split in the talent sync path.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by making local authoritative progression sync more internally complete before any broader status-model work.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative unlocked talent sync and 0.29.12 version presentation.
